program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 8.0, 22.0),      # gain device gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),       # gain device L
    "gmid4": (18.0, 10.0, 22.0),     # follower gm/Id
    "I4":    (12e-6, 5e-6, 16e-6),   # follower bias current
    "Rf":    (420e3, 400e3, 600e3),  # feedback resistor
    "Cf":    (5e-15, 1e-15, 20e-15), # feedback cap
    "vds1":  (0.3, 0.18, 0.45),      # target VDS of gain device
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    Rf, Cf, I4 = p["Rf"], p["Cf"], p["I4"]

    # gain device carries exactly IREF
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], iref, vds=p["vds1"])
    vout = m1.vgs
    m4 = lut.size("n", p["gmid4"], 0.15, I4, vds=vdd - vout, vsb=vout)
    vx = vout + m4.vgs
    m2 = lut.size("n", 14.0, 0.15, iref, vds=max(vx - p["vds1"], 0.2), vsb=p["vds1"])
    vcas = p["vds1"] + m2.vgs
    Rtot = 2.0e6
    R2 = Rtot * vcas / vdd; R1 = Rtot - R2
    Idiv = vdd / Rtot
    Rt = vout / I4

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "ibias", "vcas", "d1", "vss", m2)
    n.dev("M4", "vdd", "ibias", "vout", "vss", m4)
    n.R("RT", "vout", "vss", Rt)
    n.R("RF", "vout", "iin", Rf)
    n.C("CF", "vout", "iin", Cf)
    n.R("RB1", "vdd", "vcas", R1)
    n.R("RB2", "vcas", "vss", R2)
    n.C("CB", "vcas", "vss", 100e-15)

    gm1 = m1.gm; gm4 = m4.gm; gmb4 = m4.gmbs
    gx = m1.gds * m2.gds / max(m2.gm, 1e-9)
    Cx = m2.cdd + m4.cgd + 0.15 * max(m4.cgg - m4.cgd, 0) + 2e-15
    Cin = cpd + m1.cgg
    gL = 1.0 / Rt + m4.gds
    CL2 = cl + 1e-15
    f = np.logspace(3, 10, 2000); s = 2j * PI * f
    Yf = 1.0 / Rf + s * Cf
    K = (Yf - gm4 * gm1 / (gx + s * Cx)) / (gm4 + gmb4 + gL + s * CL2 + Yf)
    Z = K / (s * Cin + Yf * (1 - K))
    Zm = np.abs(Z); Z0 = Zm[0]
    below = np.where(Zm < Z0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3db = float(f[below[0]]) if len(below) else 1e10
    zt = db(Z0)

    w = 2 * PI * 1e6
    en2 = 4 * kT * 1.0 / gm1
    in2 = 4 * kT / Rf + en2 * (w * (Cin + Cf)) ** 2
    power = vdd * (iref + I4 + Idiv)

    return n, {"zt_dbohm": zt, "f3db": f3db, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout, "in_noise_1m": math.sqrt(in2)}
